categories.main_business_segments: Matsuda Sangyo operates two primary business segments: the Precious Metals Related Business, which includes precious metals recycling, refining, sales of bullion and electronic materials, and industrial waste collection and processing; and the Food Related Business, which involves the import, processing, and wholesale of food raw materials such as seafood, agricultural, and livestock products, as well as logistics services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precious metals refining and recycling technologies, including efficient concentration and separation processes, environmentally friendly refining methods (such as nitrate-free techniques), and high-purity product manufacturing. It also develops specialized cleaning and stripping technologies for semiconductor and electronic component manufacturing, as well as plating chemicals and high-purity vacuum deposition materials. In the food segment, the focus is on quality control and safe, reliable supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers for the precious metals segment are in the electronics, semiconductor, automotive, chemical, and jewelry industries, as well as companies generating industrial waste. The food segment primarily serves food manufacturers, processed food companies, and the food service industry, supplying raw materials for products such as surimi, seafood, meat, and vegetables.
categories.geographic_coverage: Matsuda Sangyo has a strong presence in Japan and operates internationally across Asia, including subsidiaries and operations in Thailand, the Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Taiwan, Korea, China, India, and Indonesia. The majority of sales are in Japan, but overseas sales, especially in Asia, are growing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. In precious metals, it collects and processes scrap and waste, refines metals, and supplies bullion and materials to manufacturers. In food, it acts as an importer, processor, and wholesaler, supplying raw materials to downstream food manufacturers and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the revenue base through investment, expanding new revenue sources, and enhancing ESG management. R&D focuses on resource recycling, environmental conservation, high purity and high performance materials, and technologies for lithium-ion battery recycling and GHG reduction. The company is also accelerating digital transformation (DX), global expansion, and supply chain sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of refined precious metals, electronic materials, and plating chemicals, as well as fees for industrial waste processing. In the food segment, revenue comes from the sale of imported and processed food raw materials and logistics services. Some transactions, especially in food and electronic materials, are recognized on a net basis as agent transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese and Asian precious metals refiners and recyclers, as well as large trading companies in the food raw materials sector. Matsuda Sangyo positions itself as a leading integrated resource recycling and food raw materials supplier, with a strong domestic market share and growing international presence, particularly in Asia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 468.8 billion yen (up 30% year-on-year), with operating profit of 12.7 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 9.5 billion yen. The company has shown robust growth, especially in the precious metals segment, and targets further expansion with a forecast of 490 billion yen in sales for the next fiscal year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Matsuda Sangyo emphasizes its comprehensive resource recycling capabilities, environmental responsibility, and high-quality, high-purity products in the precious metals segment. In food, it differentiates through reliable global sourcing, strict quality control, and the ability to provide safe, sustainable, and diverse food raw materials. The company’s integrated approach and commitment to ESG and supply chain sustainability are key differentiators.
